note: Intent router (step R of the main pipeline), after the emergency and safety checks. Nutrition related (sent to the nutrition plugin): foods, dishes, recipes, nutrients, meals, the programme's food rules, and statements about allergies, diet or conditions. Everything else (symptoms, medicines on their own, exercise, sleep, greetings, other topics) is answered by the main assistant. A condition or health word with no food or diet word is unsure: the router asks one question. Word lists are drafts for Swastham to review against real traffic. IR-0.4.0 (27 Oct 2026): model_topics lists the only main-assistant topics a model may word; every other topic gets its reviewed reply. The live run with Groq showed the model writing a poem for an off-topic request, giving walking advice and describing itself as chatting about medicines and symptoms (evals LP-01 to LP-03).
safety_topics_note: Checked before food words, because 'can I stop metformin if I follow this diet' and 'will this diet cure my diabetes' have a food word but need the fixed line, not food advice. A change verb counts only within three words of a medicine word ('stop my insulin', 'metformin band kar du'), so 'skip lunch, I take insulin' stays a food question. Doctor to review.
child_note: A question about what a child or baby should eat or be given gets the fixed child reply, before food words. Cooking for the family ('what can I make for my kids') is still a recipe question. Doctor to review.
clarify_question: Is your question about food or your diet? Say yes and I'll answer it with your food plan, or no and I'll answer it in general.
clarify_which_food: Which food or dish do you mean? For example: is dal good for my health, or can I eat poha.

main_replies.greeting: Hello! I'm {assistant}. Ask me about food, meals, recipes or the programme's food rules.
main_replies.thanks: You're welcome. Ask me any time.
main_replies.about: I'm {assistant}, an automated helper, not a doctor and not a person. I can look up the nutrition of foods and dishes, suggest recipes and explain {programme}'s food rules. For medical advice please talk to your doctor.
main_replies.exercise: I can't advise on exercise here. Please ask {coach} what activity suits you. I can help with food, meals and recipes.
main_replies.sleep: I can't advise on sleep here. If poor sleep goes on, please talk to your doctor. I can help with food, meals and recipes.
main_replies.medicine: I can't advise on medicines or doses. Please ask your doctor.
main_replies.symptom: I can't judge symptoms. If it continues or gets worse, please talk to your doctor.
main_replies.cure: I can't promise that a diet will cure or reverse a condition. Food can support your treatment, and your doctor checks your progress and decides about any medicines. I can help with food, meals and recipes in {programme}.
main_replies.child: The programme and my answers are for adults. For what a child or baby should eat, please ask your child's doctor. I'm happy to help with family recipes or with food questions for you.
main_replies.general: I'm best with food and diet questions, such as what to cook, the calories in a dish, or the programme's food rules. For other topics, please ask {coach}.

noted_line: Thank you for telling me; I've noted it for your food answers.

locked_lines.medicine: Please don't start, stop or change a medicine without your doctor.
locked_lines.cure: Please don't start, stop or change a medicine without your doctor.
locked_lines.symptom: If you feel shaky, sweaty or dizzy, especially if you take diabetes medicine, eat something and contact your doctor.

model_topics_note: Topics whose reply a model may word, after the checks below. Greeting, about, exercise, sleep and other topics define what the assistant does, so they are sent as reviewed text only (the binding's behaviour rule: an unsupported request is answered from approved wording, not improvised). Cure and child can never be listed: a start-up check refuses them.

model_reply_deny.note: A model reply on these topics that names a medicine change or a dose is refused and the reviewed template is sent. The locked line is added after this check.
